title: Every attempt answers 500: the budget ends after five attempts and the caller sees the last response
notes: The retry budget is five attempts including the first, so four retries with delays 1, 2, 4 and 8 s; maximumAttempts is total attempts, not retries. `retry` script entries repeat from the last entry, which is why one entry models five identical 500s. A plain tool egress forwards the final 500 status and body unchanged (no ModelGatewayError), which is why provider_error is none even though the call failed for the caller. client_outcome describes the gateway stream, not the model result: the stream completes with a 500 that the caller must treat as a failure.
